grammar_title: 动名词(-ing 形式作主语 / 宾语)
source: 上外版选择性必修二 Unit 3 Grammar in Use:-ing forms used as subjects and objects(动名词作主语、动词宾语、介词宾语)。句子地道、慈善主题、答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项)。

points.point: 动名词作主语(谓语用单数)
points.overview: 动词的 -ing 形式可像名词一样作句子主语,表泛指/经常性的行为;作主语时被看作一个整体,谓语动词用单数(is/makes/...)。
enjoy, finish, mind, admit, avoid, consider, suggest, keep, practise, deny, imagine, give up, feel like, can't help 等动词后只接 -ing 形式作宾语,不接 to do。
介词(for, at, in, of, by, before, after, without, instead of 等)以及 look forward to / be used to / be committed to 中作介词的 to 后,只能接 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: ____ to a food bank helps families who have nothing to eat.
questions.explanation: 句首作主语应用动名词 → Donating;原形/三单/过去式都不能作主语。

questions.stem: ____ used books gives them a useful second life.
questions.explanation: 主语位置用动名词 → Collecting。

questions.stem: ____ the elderly at the nursing home brings them great joy.
questions.explanation: 作主语用动名词 → Visiting。

questions.stem: ____ money for the village school is not always easy.
questions.explanation: 主语用动名词 → Raising。

questions.stem: ____ others in trouble is something we can all do.
questions.explanation: 作主语用动名词 → Helping。

questions.stem: ____ at the animal shelter taught me real responsibility.
questions.explanation: 主语位置用动名词 → Volunteering。

questions.stem: ____ warm clothes to the homeless is a truly kind act.
questions.explanation: 作主语用动名词 → Giving。

questions.stem: ____ part in the charity run made the whole class proud.
questions.explanation: 主语用动名词 → Taking。

questions.stem: ____ for a stranger's coffee can brighten their whole day.
questions.explanation: 作主语用动名词 → Paying。

questions.stem: ____ kindness to others often costs very little.
questions.explanation: 主语用动名词 → Showing。

questions.stem: Helping people in need ____ a rewarding experience for everyone.
questions.explanation: 动名词作主语视作单数,谓语用 is。

questions.stem: Donating blood ____ the lives of strangers every single day.
questions.explanation: 动名词主语用单数谓语 → saves。

questions.stem: Volunteering at the shelter ____ a lot of patience and care.
questions.explanation: 动名词主语用单数 → requires。

questions.stem: Caring for sick animals ____ hard but meaningful work.
questions.explanation: 动名词作主语用单数 → is。

questions.stem: Giving without expecting anything back ____ true kindness.
questions.explanation: 动名词主语用单数 → shows。

questions.stem: Raising money for the village school ____ our main goal this term.
questions.explanation: 动名词主语用单数 → remains。

questions.stem: Reading to blind children ____ them a window into wonderful stories.
questions.explanation: 动名词主语用单数 → gives。

questions.stem: Collecting old toys for the hospital ____ the sick children very happy.
questions.explanation: 动名词主语用单数 → makes。

questions.stem: Teaching young kids about charity ____ not always easy.
questions.explanation: 动名词作主语用单数 → is。

questions.stem: Sharing food with the hungry ____ a real difference in their lives.
questions.explanation: 动名词主语用单数 → makes。

questions.stem: She enjoys ____ at the local food bank every weekend.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后只接动名词 → helping。

questions.stem: We have finished ____ all the donated clothes by size.
questions.explanation: finish 后接动名词 → sorting。

questions.stem: He suggested ____ a charity sale at the school next month.
questions.explanation: suggest 后接动名词 → holding。

questions.stem: Would you mind ____ these boxes of food to the truck?
questions.explanation: mind 后接动名词 → carrying。

questions.stem: The volunteers kept ____ until every family had been served.
questions.explanation: keep 后接动名词 → working。

questions.stem: They are considering ____ a fund for the flood victims.
questions.explanation: consider 后接动名词 → starting。

questions.stem: I can't help ____ sorry for the homeless man out in the cold.
questions.explanation: can't help doing 忍不住做 → feeling。

questions.stem: He admitted ____ the donation box at home by mistake.
questions.explanation: admit 后接动名词 → leaving。

questions.stem: Please try to avoid ____ food; give it to charity instead.
questions.explanation: avoid 后接动名词 → wasting。

questions.stem: Our class practises ____ kindness in small ways every day.
questions.explanation: practise 后接动名词 → showing。

questions.stem: She doesn't mind ____ extra hours to prepare the charity event.
questions.explanation: mind 后接动名词 → spending。

questions.stem: The children enjoyed ____ gift bags for the kids in hospital.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后接动名词 → making。

questions.stem: After the storm, the team didn't give up ____ for the lost dog.
questions.explanation: give up 后接动名词 → searching。

questions.stem: The shop owner suggested ____ the unsold bread to a shelter.
questions.explanation: suggest 后接动名词 → donating。

questions.stem: We must keep ____ people about the cause until everyone knows.
questions.explanation: keep 后接动名词 → telling。

questions.stem: Do you feel like ____ in the charity marathon this year?
questions.explanation: feel like doing 想做 → running。

questions.stem: He denied ____ the credit for the donation, though it was his idea.
questions.explanation: deny 后接动名词 → taking。

questions.stem: Imagine ____ a whole village with clean water to drink.
questions.explanation: imagine 后接动名词 → providing。

questions.stem: The patients enjoy ____ songs sung by the visiting students.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后接动名词 → hearing。

questions.stem: Have you finished ____ the posters for the book drive?
questions.explanation: finish 后接动名词 → designing。

questions.stem: Thank you for ____ us with the charity sale all afternoon.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后接动名词 → helping。

questions.stem: She is very good at ____ money for worthy causes.
questions.explanation: 介词 at 后接动名词 → raising。

questions.stem: Instead of ____ the old clothes away, they gave them to charity.
questions.explanation: instead of 后接动名词 → throwing。

questions.stem: We raised a lot of money by ____ homemade cakes at the fair.
questions.explanation: 介词 by 后接动名词 → selling。

questions.stem: He is interested in ____ for the homeless shelter this winter.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后接动名词 → volunteering。

questions.stem: I'm really looking forward to ____ part in next month's charity run.
questions.explanation: look forward to 的 to 是介词,后接动名词 → taking。

questions.stem: Before ____ the event, we made a careful plan together.
questions.explanation: 介词 before 后接动名词 → organising。

questions.stem: After ____ all the donations, the team thanked everyone warmly.
questions.explanation: 介词 after 后接动名词 → counting。

questions.stem: They succeeded in ____ enough money to rebuild the school.
questions.explanation: succeed in 的 in 后接动名词 → collecting。

questions.stem: She thanked the volunteers for ____ their whole weekend to help.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后接动名词 → giving。

questions.stem: We can make a difference by ____ just a little of our time.
questions.explanation: 介词 by 后接动名词 → offering。

questions.stem: He is very keen on ____ at the animal shelter on Saturdays.
questions.explanation: be keen on 的 on 后接动名词 → working。

questions.stem: They have got used to ____ food to the shelter every Friday.
questions.explanation: be/get used to 的 to 是介词,后接动名词 → bringing。

questions.stem: Everyone is capable of ____ kindness to others in some way.
questions.explanation: be capable of 的 of 后接动名词 → showing。

questions.stem: Apart from ____ clothes, you can also donate books and toys.
questions.explanation: apart from 后接动名词 → donating。

questions.stem: She left the party without ____ anyone how much she had given.
questions.explanation: 介词 without 后接动名词 → telling。

questions.stem: We are committed to ____ clean water to the whole village.
questions.explanation: be committed to 的 to 是介词,后接动名词 → providing。

questions.stem: He felt very proud of ____ a difference in his own community.
questions.explanation: be proud of 的 of 后接动名词 → making。

questions.stem: The poster is about ____ warm coats for the winter charity drive.
questions.explanation: 介词 about 后接动名词 → gathering。

questions.stem: Thank you for ____ so generously to such a worthy cause.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后接动名词 → contributing。
